data.name: BoardOfDirectorsContent
data.value: At EMDAD , we believe that wise leadership and strategic guidance are the foundation of the company’s success and sustainability. Therefore, the Board of Directors is composed of a group of leaders with extensive and diverse expertise in the fields of defense and civil industry. The board is responsible for making crucial strategic decisions that ensure continued growth and the expansion of our operations in both local and international markets.

data.name: BoardOfDirectorsDescription1
data.value:
The leadership of the EMDAD Board of Directors is characterized by social responsibility, with the board considering the impact of the company on society and the environment. The board adopts strategies aimed at reducing environmental impact and promoting sustainability in all business operations.
Through the wise guidance of the Board of Directors, EMDAD continues to succeed and evolve in providing advanced solutions across various sectors, while maintaining a commitment to transparency, innovation, and quality.
This section outlines the structure of the Board of Directors, who work towards achieving the company’s goals. They also reflect the professionalism of the company and are committed to making well-considered strategic decisions that contribute to its long-term growth and success.

data.name: CompanyPolicyContent
data.value: EMDAD Company aims to become a center for local, international, and regional supply in accordance with national and global quality standards and specifications, leading to excellence in logistical performance. This will be achieved through a highly skilled team capable of competing in the global business and financial markets, meeting their needs, and upholding ethical values.

data.name: CompanyPostsContent
data.value: By the grace and success of Allah, the company was officially launched on the day of announcing the policy of Imdad Trading and Supplies Company for local, regional, and international clients, aiming to achieve the highest level of satisfaction and trust in the services provided to them.

data.name: CompanyVisionContent
data.value: Emdad strives for leadership and excellence in the field of general supplies, aiming to become the most trusted company in local, regional, and international logistics supply services.
